name: libjpeg-turbo
notes: Added 2026-10-10 for Web Tranche 3B milestone B2: WebCore's JPEG decoder and the bundled Skia (SkJpegCodec uses jpeg_crop_scanline/jpeg_skip_scanlines) need libjpeg-turbo, not IJG libjpeg; WebKit's FindJPEG requires >= 1.5.2.

First recipe with build.system cmake (tools/crt-port-build.py build_cmake_port: generated toolchain file naming the CRT wrappers, find roots limited to the port prefix and the sysroot, Linux and macOS hosts).

WITH_SIMD=0: the SIMD code needs NASM on the build host; the portable C paths are used until a SIMD build is wanted (a performance item, not a correctness one). TurboJPEG, tools and tests are off: the WebKit consumers use the libjpeg API only.
